segments.text: Become more efficient with background posting. In Business Central, you can let the system post journals and documents in the background, so you can continue working on other tasks and not have to wait for posting to complete.

This is especially useful when posting journals and documents with significant amount of lines. You can set this up in pages such as general ledger setup, sales and receivable setup, and purchase and payable setup.

Let's go to purchase and payable setup to learn how to enable background posting. I bring up the tell me search with Alt Q. I search for purchase and payables, and select purchase and payable setup from the list.

I browse down to find the background posting section. I enable post with job queue. And in this case, I also enable post and print with job queue, because I want to get notified on my role center when my purchase documents have been posted and printed.

We'll see how that works. Let's now go and post and print a purchase order. Go to purchasing in the top navigation menu, select purchase orders, and I select the purchase order that I want to post and print.
I then select post and post and print. I want to receive an invoice this purchase order, and select okay. Now it says that the purchase order has been scheduled for posting in the background.
That's great. Let's go back to the role center. I'm back at the role center, and I expect to find the posted purchase order sitting in my report inbox.
I browse down to find the report inbox, and as I expect, I find two posted documents here. One is the printed purchase receipt from the purchase order, and another is the posted purchase invoice.
I can open these documents in OneDrive by selecting the ellipsis menu, and select open in OneDrive. This will open the document in OneDrive if you have cloud files enabled for your Business Central.
So, with this, we learned how we can post documents in the background and see when they're posted when they turn up in our reporting box and open these files with OneDrive.
